name: jev
description: Cuts harness cost with the Jev classifier (TypeSafe AI). A fail-open Jev client, a ledger of every Jev call and per-turn session cost, /jev to print its summary, and an opt-in router that picks a cheaper model and lower effort at cache-cold points.

timeoutMs.title: Jev timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long a Jev call may take before it is abandoned and the turn goes on without it.

router.title: Model router
router.description: "on": Jev picks the model and effort for each conversation and each inherited subagent, never above the one you are on. Your prompt text is sent to TypeSafe AI. The JEV_COMPONENTS environment variable, when set, overrides this.

shadow.title: Shadow proposals
shadow.description: "on": Jev records what the enabled components would do without changing the model, effort, tool result, files, compaction or available agents. The JEV_COMPONENTS environment variable, when set, overrides this.

lanes.title: Delegation lanes
lanes.description: "on": when the router holds the current model for a hard session, offer a lane agent for self-contained work such as multi-file search, bounded implementation or verification. Delegation costs a context re-read, so it is not offered after a router downgrade. The JEV_COMPONENTS environment variable, when set, overrides this.

find.title: Relevant path suggestions
find.description: "on": register jev-find so Jev can suggest which of up to 50 candidate paths matter for the current task. The model may ignore the suggestion. The JEV_COMPONENTS environment variable, when set, overrides this.

toolDescribe.title: Tool description deferral
toolDescribe.description: "on": ask Jev which Web, MCP-server, notebook and browser tool groups are probably needed for the task, deferring low-relevance groups behind ToolSearch. The JEV_COMPONENTS environment variable, when set, overrides this.

models.title: Router model allowlist
models.description: Comma-separated model tiers Jev may choose; unknown names are ignored. JEV_MODELS overrides this.

minConfidence.title: Router minimum confidence
minConfidence.description: A Jev routing answer below this confidence (0 to 1) leaves the model and effort as they are.

subtleThreshold.title: Subtle correctness threshold
subtleThreshold.description: A Jev subtle-correctness probability above this threshold (0 to 1) keeps the current model and effort.

offload.title: Tool output offload
offload.description: "on": a Bash, WebFetch or MCP result over the offload threshold is saved whole under .claude/jev/ and the model gets its head, tail and the middle parts Jev finds needed for the task. The task and the tool output are sent to TypeSafe AI. The JEV_COMPONENTS environment variable, when set, overrides this.

offloadChars.title: Offload threshold (chars)
offloadChars.description: A tool result whose text is longer than this is offloaded (at least 1000).

keepThreshold.title: Offload keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: A middle part of an offloaded result is kept when Jev's probability that it is needed (0 to 1) is at least this.

offloadTimeoutMs.title: Offload Jev timeout (ms)
offloadTimeoutMs.description: How long the offload's Jev call may take before the result falls back to plain head/tail.

compact.title: Jev-guided compaction
compact.description: "on" (experimental): once the context is between compactFromPct and compactToPct, at the end of a turn Jev judges to be a natural pause, the conversation is compacted. The last prompt and a summary of the answer are sent to TypeSafe AI. The JEV_COMPONENTS environment variable, when set, overrides this.

compactFromPct.title: Compaction window start (%)
compactFromPct.description: A natural-pause compaction is considered from this context fill (0 to 100).

compactToPct.title: Compaction window end (%)
compactToPct.description: At or above this context fill (0 to 100) the engine's own autocompact is left to act.

compactMinTurns.title: Turns between compactions
compactMinTurns.description: A natural-pause compaction waits at least this many turns after the last compaction.

pauseThreshold.title: Pause threshold
pauseThreshold.description: Jev's probability (0 to 1) that the task is at a natural pause needed to compact.
